subject: prior on θ1 for autoregressive model of order p

messages.author: 57338e36f04c0bcf
messages.subject: prior on θ1 for autoregressive model of order p
parts:
Hello!


I was looking at the documentation page for AR(p) model (https://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/r-inla.org/doc/latent/ar.pdf) and was wondering what is the prior on θ1. Thanks!

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] prior on θ1 for autoregressive model of order p
parts:
its described here

https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/jtsa.12242


and are avail as inla.pc.{d,p,q,r}cor0

with default parameters

> inla.models()$latent$ar$hyper$theta2$prior
[1] "pc.cor0"
attr(,"inla.read.only")
[1] FALSE
> inla.models()$latent$ar$hyper$theta2$param
[1] 0.5 0.5
attr(,"inla.read.only")
[1] FALSE

>
